name: Bachmann E-Z Track (HO)
description: Bachmann E-Z Track is a sectional HO track system with integrated gray plastic roadbed. It is sold in two rail materials with shared geometry: nickel silver (current production, recommended) and steel (legacy/budget, common in older starter sets). The two materials are mechanically interchangeable but should not be mixed electrically on the same block due to differing conductivity and oxidation behaviour. Curves are described by radius and arc sweep; the long-standing standards are 18" radius (30°, 12 sections per circle) and 22" radius (22.5°, 16 sections per circle). Wide-radius curves (26", 28", 33.25") are newer and are typically supplied in 11.25° sweeps. Turnouts are offered in #4 (sharper, the original) and #6 (broader, newer) frog sizes, each in left/right and manual/remote variants. SKUs are 5-digit Bachmann part numbers; nickel-silver and steel versions of identical geometry use distinct numbers.

pieces.label: 9" straight (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: 9 in × 25.4 = 228.6 mm. Nickel-silver workhorse; most widely cited Bachmann E-Z Track piece. SKU 44581 is consistently listed across Walthers / Trainz / Tower Hobbies / ModelTrainStuff catalogue listings but was not live-verified at this snapshot — see notes.

pieces.label: 9" straight (steel)
pieces.notes: Steel-rail equivalent of 44581. Same 228.6 mm length and roadbed footprint. SKU 44811 is the commonly cited steel 9" straight.

pieces.label: 6" straight (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: 6 in × 25.4 = 152.4 mm. SKU not asserted here — multiple plausible numbers (44593 / 44594) exist in dealer listings; left null until live-verified per the schema's ‘empty is honest’ rule.

pieces.label: 6" straight (steel)
pieces.notes: Steel-rail 6" straight. Often only supplied in starter sets; standalone retail SKU not confidently confirmed.

pieces.label: 3" straight (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: 3 in × 25.4 = 76.2 mm. Standard fitter section. SKU 44591 is the commonly listed nickel-silver part number.

pieces.label: 3" straight (steel)
pieces.notes: Steel-rail 3" fitter. SKU not confirmed; geometry identical to nickel-silver counterpart.

pieces.label: 2.25" straight (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Quarter-section fitter. 2.25 in × 25.4 = 57.15 mm. Used to close gaps where a 3" fitter is too long.

pieces.label: 1.5" straight (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Short fitter. 1.5 in × 25.4 = 38.1 mm. Listed in some Bachmann documentation as a half-fitter; SKU varies across catalogues and is left null until confirmed.

pieces.label: 18" radius curve, 30° (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: 12 sections form a full 360° circle. radius 18 in × 25.4 = 457.2 mm; arc length = 2π × 457.2 × (30 / 360) = 239.389 mm. SKU 44501 is the standard nickel-silver 18"R curve.

pieces.label: 18" radius curve, 30° (steel)
pieces.notes: Steel-rail equivalent of 44501. Bachmann starter-set staple.

pieces.label: 22" radius curve, 22.5° (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: 16 sections form a full 360° circle. radius 22 in × 25.4 = 558.8 mm; arc length = 2π × 558.8 × (22.5 / 360) = 219.450 mm. SKU 44505 is the typical nickel-silver listing.

pieces.label: 22" radius curve, 22.5° (steel)
pieces.notes: Steel-rail equivalent of 44505.

pieces.label: 26" radius curve, 11.25° (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Wide-radius (32 sections per circle). radius 26 in × 25.4 = 660.4 mm; arc = 2π × 660.4 × (11.25 / 360) = 129.708 mm. SKU not asserted; geometry is the standard 11.25° wide-radius sweep.

pieces.label: 28" radius curve, 11.25° (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Wide-radius. radius 28 in × 25.4 = 711.2 mm; arc = 2π × 711.2 × (11.25 / 360) = 139.687 mm. Some catalogues alternatively list 28"R as 13.75°; 11.25° matches the most common modern E-Z Track wide-radius set. SKU not asserted.

pieces.label: 33.25" radius curve, 11.25° (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Widest E-Z Track radius. radius 33.25 in × 25.4 = 844.55 mm; arc = 2π × 844.55 × (11.25 / 360) = 165.832 mm. SKU not asserted.

pieces.label: #4 manual turnout, left (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Mainline-route length matches a 9" straight (228.6 mm), so a #4 substitutes directly for a 9" section in a planning gap. NMRA #4 frog ≈ 14° divergence; Bachmann does not publish the exact divergence so it is left null.

pieces.label: #4 manual turnout, right (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Right-hand mirror of 44559.

pieces.label: #4 remote turnout, left (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Powered (remote) version of 44559. Same geometry.

pieces.label: #4 remote turnout, right (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Powered (remote) version of 44558.

pieces.label: #6 manual turnout, left (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: #6 is broader than #4 (≈9.5° divergence). Bachmann does not publish a precise overall-length on its product page; left null per the schema's ‘empty is honest’ rule. Common dealer listings give 9"-equivalent multiples plus a fitter, but exact numbers vary across listings.

pieces.label: #6 manual turnout, right (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Right-hand mirror of 44131.

pieces.label: #6 remote turnout, left (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Powered version of 44131.

pieces.label: #6 remote turnout, right (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Powered version of 44132.

pieces.label: 45° crossing (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Symmetric crossing. Overall length along each route matches a 9" section (228.6 mm) per the long-standing E-Z Track convention. SKU not asserted here pending live-verify.

pieces.label: 90° crossing (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Symmetric 90° crossing. Bachmann's published documentation has not consistently given an overall route length for this piece — frequently described only by its grid footprint. Left null until verified.

pieces.label: 9" rerailer / re-railer (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: Drop-in replacement for a 9" straight; molded ramps guide derailed wheels back to the rail. SKU varies by year and region — left null.

pieces.label: 9" terminal rerailer with wires (nickel silver)
pieces.notes: 9" rerailer pre-wired as the layout's power feed. Same 228.6 mm length as a plain 9" straight. SKU not asserted.

pieces.label: Hayes bumper / end-of-track stop
pieces.notes: Plug-on Hayes-style bumper that clips into the end of any E-Z Track section; does not add measurable centerline length, so length_mm is null. SKU not asserted.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/bachmann-ez-track-ho.md for per-system caveats.
